elara_gc06_exp_lattice_diagnosed.title: The Lattice Under Strain
elara_gc06_exp_lattice_diagnosed.interpretation: Elara's archive contradiction now matches a live regional failure pattern: the Echo is stressing connected systems rather than producing one isolated anomaly.

valerius_gc06_exp_surface_containment.title: Contain What Is Failing
valerius_gc06_exp_surface_containment.interpretation: The player accepts a bounded local containment strategy: ordinary action remains viable even without optional capability combinations.

gronk_gc06_exp_structural_steward.title: Reroute the Lattice Load
gronk_gc06_exp_structural_steward.interpretation: Willow's slow-system reading and Gronk's load-path judgment combine into a structural response that reroutes pressure instead of treating each visible failure separately.

lyra_gc06_exp_countermodeler.title: Phase Against the Echo
lyra_gc06_exp_countermodeler.interpretation: Elara's contradiction-first inquiry and Lyra's adversarial calibration combine into a response that treats the Echo as a pattern to model and phase against.

lyra_gc06_exp_chrono_crypt_route.title: The Local Fix Is Not the Countermeasure
lyra_gc06_exp_chrono_crypt_route.interpretation: The local lattice can be stabilized, but Lyra recognizes that the repeating phase structure points to the Chrono-Crypt as the place to derive a real countermeasure.

lyra_memory_gc06_chrono_crypt_route.title: The Route Beneath the Local Fix
lyra_memory_gc06_chrono_crypt_route.summary: You stabilized the local lattice, then accepted with Lyra that containment is not a countermeasure. The repeating phase points toward the Chrono-Crypt.
lyra_memory_gc06_chrono_crypt_route.protagonistView: The local response bought time. The crypt may explain how to stop needing local responses.
lyra_memory_gc06_chrono_crypt_route.targetView: The player can distinguish a successful intervention from a solved problem. That makes a deeper joint investigation possible.
